explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/642: let f(n) be the maximum number of edges in an n-vertex graph in which every cycle has more vertices than chords. Is f(n) ≪ n? The page lists it as open. maxEdges n is that maximum over graphs on Fin n. CyclesHaveMoreVerticesThanChords compares the number of chords (edges of G joining cycle vertices that are not cycle edges) with c.length, which is the number of vertices of the cycle. The statement asks for maxEdges = O(n). Faithful.
